top_signals.title: War-Driven Cost Squeeze Alarms Companies, Bank of America Says
top_signals.summary: What began as an oil-market shock from the Iran war has broadened into a cost squeeze across the US, with business owners growing significantly more concerned about commodity prices.

top_signals.title: Google-Tied Prepaid Bond Deals Delayed Due to Lackluster Demand
top_signals.summary: Two prepaid energy deals totaling $3 billion, which featured Google parent company Alphabet Inc. as funding recipient, were delayed due to lackluster investor demand amid market volatility, according to a person familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Australia’s Leader to Navigate Trade, Security in Talks With Xi
top_signals.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will aim to navigate delicate security and trade issues when he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday, seeking to ease access for commodities to its biggest export partner.
